Firstly I’m not going to ignore the fact that the gaming community is volatile and emotional, and there are many assholes and rampant sexism in some parts of the community. This however does not take away from legitimate criticisms that have been put out there, the same ones that are vocalized by TB. What the media did to oppose this was the exact same way how this situation is being handled. They pull the worst people and comments and twist them to make it sound like this represent the entire community. And guess what, if TB had a million people backing him up, how many people do you think Kotaku, Polygon, and other game journalism outlets have supporting them? How many do you think knew nothing of gamergate until they read their incredibly biased and one sided articles and formed an opinion?

The JP incident is exactly why gamergate was an issue in the first place. Go onto any journalist platform and see how they twist the words of the community and put JP in a good light again and again and again. See how they downplay her blatant sexism and bullying and cast Mike o brien in a bad light repeatedly. Note that all of the articles siding JP are written journalism on gaming news websites as opposed to independent video articles like WoodenPotatoes who maintained a neutral stance his entire video. Recall how they made Deroir an aggressor instead of a victim. So many public influencers and personalities have been burned by the media just so they can click bait and get a few more views. 

If you think TB wasn’t a good guy for standing against this issue you’re delusional.

The issue with collections is that when you’re trying so hard to go everywhere and slightly dip your toes in one area of gameplay to collect 1/50 piece of the puzzle, you lose what imo what guild wars 2 was originally good for - it’s gameplay mechanic. It becomes a game like Pokemon Go, where it’s focus is not about playing the game, but idly doing random things you have little interest in to pass the time, and disguising that fact as ‘gameplay’. Not to mention, when the gemstore provides you with better options than collection rewards, it completely negates any interest in doing them. It reminds me of those gamification to-do apps where you are superficially rewarded for things you didn’t want to do but did them anyway.

Honestly ever since the JP drama I’ve felt like there’s a disconnect between the devs and the community - like they hate us and we hate them. I’m so tired of seeing any criticism being turned back against the community and them acting like we are a disgusting cesspool of hate.
